summary:
VMSG_PROGRESS_REPORT.pdf (6 pages, dated 2026-07-05, "Prepared by: Engineering") is the Phase 1 build progress report for the Vedic Math Speed Gym platform, built against client RFP v7.2 and reconciled with a legacy "v5.2 corpus" architecture. It states everything reported was verified against live infrastructure or automated tests. Work spanned three streams: (a) advisory/design — four Markdown deliverables (VMSG_TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md, VMSG_CLIENT_BRIEF.md, VMSG_CONTENT_READINESS.md, plus an RFP assessment inside the architecture doc that flagged 8 substantive RFP issues: timeline vs scope, premature models, sampling risk, bot/COPPA, infra cliff); (b) Sprint 0 foundation — a git monorepo (141 tracked files, 9 commits, repo at E:\claude\Claude\vedic-speed-gym, i.e., originally on a Windows dev machine) with docker-compose dev stack, PostgreSQL 15 + pgvector (39 tables, 164 indexes), Neo4j 5 (14 constraints, 30 indexes), Redis 7 + PgBouncer, content seeded (3,585 Neo4j nodes + 8,678 relationships; 4,943 RAG chunks with 1536-dim pgvector embeddings in Postgres, cosine similarity verified with self-distance 0.0), after finding and fixing 7 real schema defects in the delivered v2/v5 schemas; (c) Sprint 2 practice engine — TypeScript packages implementing BKT mastery tracking (posteriors, learn step, decay, fluid/fragile/fractured states), a 60/20/20 session allocator with persona overrides and age time multipliers, spaced-repetition scheduler (decay-priority, sinking threshold, review queue), trinary cold-start calibration (warm-up priors, ANS baseline, 3-path routing), practice runtime (processAttempt + composeSession), 5 of 16 Vedic sutras (self-verifying with step-by-step methods), and seeded parametric generators (mulberry32; 625 generated problems independently re-derived, all exact) — 46 automated tests all passing (33/33 psychometrics, 13/13 vedic-math). A live in-browser adaptive practice screen runs the whole engine client-side (offline, no DB/network); verified behavior: one correct answer moved mastery FRACTURED 35% -> FRAGILE 82% (mathematically exact for a difficulty-1 item) showing the Nikhilam method, zero console errors.

Sprint 1 (auth & payments, Stripe/Razorpay) was deliberately PARKED pending client decisions, along with sampling-policy sign-off, model-phasing approval, and bot-disclosure/COPPA rules. The only environment blocker noted: Docker Desktop kept auto-stopping on the dev machine, so the database-backed API demo needed Docker running (API code and error handling were complete; the data layer had been fully proven while Docker was up). Remaining build work listed with no blockers: the other 11 of 16 Vedic techniques + generators; offline persistence (Dexie/IndexedDB) + client state stores + multi-technique sessions; connecting the web app to seeded Neo4j content via the practice API (Tier-1 static + Tier-2 generated); Sprint 1 once client decisions land. Section 9 lists 8 client decisions with recommendations (proceed with recommendation unless told otherwise): keep 15-week Phase 1 timeline with advanced models phased and pre-ingested content (yes); exclude mastery-driving events from the 10% event sampling (yes, minor RFP deviation); ship DINA/3PL/Glicko-2 built-but-dormant, activate Phase 2 (yes, avoids cold-start noise); AI-opponent bots adults-only, none under-13, light disclosure (yes); optional ~$108/mo infra stage before the $836/mo jump (recommended); Razorpay-first vs Stripe-first (client's call — sets default currency/routing); Kokoro TTS narrator audio (defer unless required); content ownership — who authors the 25 remaining reference pages and clears 18 flagged problems (assign an owner before Sprint 4).

Content/data state: content_audit.py reported 807 problems at 97.8% verified, 3 empty problems, 2,457 prerequisite edges; 18 flagged problem nodes were cleaned via fix_problem_nodes.py and a generated Cypher patch (patches/fix_problems.cypher), with resync_problems_from_graph.py rebuilding the stale Postgres snapshot from the verified graph; VMSG_CONTENT_READINESS.md audited the delivered content at ~98% verified with previously-reported blockers found stale. Migration tooling (migrate.py) applies all SQL + Cypher via Python drivers (no psql/Docker needed — works with cloud DB tiers), seed.py is an idempotent dual-database import, and migrations were renumbered 00/10/20/.../70 for locale-independent ordering. The repo layout includes services/api (FastAPI: app/main.py factory+lifespan, config.py pydantic settings, db.py lazy Postgres/Neo4j/Redis clients, routers health/content/practice, tests/test_health.py, Dockerfile), packages/ (psychometrics, vedic-math, design-tokens, shared-types), apps/web (Next.js PWA: practice/page.tsx, manifest.webmanifest, next.config.js transpilePackages), apps/game-server (Node Socket.IO with JWT + event stubs), services/workers (Celery app + content tasks, 4 files), scripts/ (6 files), content/topic_browser (57 delivered data files: manifest, configs, schemas, templates), db/ (16 files incl. 60_fixes.sql for tiers/Razorpay/health/feature-flags reconciliation), and CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml: API tests, content-audit gate, JS typecheck). Note: this report predates the book-OCR/RAG "content factory" work — RAG here means the 4,943 pre-embedded chunks seeded into pgvector; no mention of Nishit K Sinha books, OCR, iOS, or Android.

workstream_notes.backend: As of 2026-07-05 the backend was: FastAPI service (app factory + lifespan, pydantic settings, lazy Postgres/Neo4j/Redis clients) with routers for /health + /ready (checks all 3 DBs), /api/topics, and /api/practice/problems + /techniques; code and error handling complete and verified, CI-safe tests in tests/test_health.py. Node Socket.IO game server exists only as JWT + event stubs. Sprint 1 (auth & payments, Stripe vs Razorpay undecided — Razorpay-first recommended for India) was never built, parked on client decisions. DB layer fully proven live: 39 Postgres tables/164 indexes, Neo4j 14 constraints/30 indexes, 7 schema defects fixed (tier enum free/pro/bundle_2/bundle_3 per SUB-01..04, user_id UUID per PAY-06, new base tables raw_events/chunks/user_technique_states, etc.), migrations 00-70 + Cypher applied by migrate.py via Python drivers (cloud-tier friendly, no psql). Practice engine lives client-side in TS packages (BKT, 60/20/20 allocator, scheduler, calibration, runtime, 46/46 tests); web app was NOT yet connected to seeded Neo4j content via the API — that plus offline persistence (Dexie/IndexedDB) and the remaining 11 of 16 Vedic techniques were the named next steps. Known env issue: Docker Desktop auto-stopping on the (Windows, E:\ drive) dev machine.
workstream_notes.data_extraction: This report predates the book-OCR extraction workstream — no mention of OCR, Nishit K Sinha, or CAT/GRE books. The content that exists came pre-delivered as content/topic_browser (57 files: manifest, configs, schemas, templates) and was audited by content_audit.py: 807 problems, 97.8% verified, 3 empty, 2,457 prerequisite edges; 18 flagged problem nodes were cleaned (fix_problem_nodes.py + patches/fix_problems.cypher) and the stale Postgres snapshot rebuilt from the verified Neo4j graph (resync_problems_from_graph.py). Open content-ownership decision: someone must be assigned before Sprint 4 to author the 25 remaining reference pages and clear the 18 flagged problems. Additionally 625 problems were produced by the seeded parametric generators (Tier-2 generative runtime) and independently re-derived exactly — so the pipeline distinguishes Tier-1 static (seeded graph) from Tier-2 generated content.
workstream_notes.rag: The 'RAG' in this report is the seeded retrieval layer, not the later content factory: 4,943 pre-embedded chunks with 1536-dim embeddings loaded into Postgres pgvector, cosine-similarity queried and verified (self-distance 0.0); a 'chunks' base table was one of the tables Engineering had to author because the delivered schemas presumed it. Celery workers exist with content tasks (services/workers, 4 files) and pg_partman/pg_cron were deferred to Phase-2a infra / Celery beat. Any book-ingestion/OCR-to-corpus pipeline (Nishit K Sinha LR/DI etc.) is absent from this report and must have been planned or built after 2026-07-05; when rebuilding that workstream, the existing pgvector chunk store (1536-d), the Neo4j content graph (3,585 nodes / 8,678 rels), and content_audit.py's verification gating (97.8% verified threshold, CI content-audit gate) are the integration points it fed into.
